episodes.task: Motion-only harness canary; ignore the simulator manipulation objective and do not actuate the gripper. Move the EEF to the final world-frame point [0.10, -0.32, 0.40]. You must choose your own safe route containing 2 to 4 total endpoints including that final point; do not copy a prewritten route from the prompt. Preview every chosen endpoint once with ik_preview_check using preserve_current_orientation=true, position_tolerance_m=0.01, orientation_tolerance_rad=0.30, and check_endpoint_collision=true. If every endpoint is executable, call follow_eef_trajectory exactly once with the ordered ik_receipt_ids, tolerance=0.01, ori_tolerance=0.30, num_steps_per_waypoint=100, and enable_collision_check=true. Inspect the returned per-waypoint receipts and stop. Report success only if all chosen endpoints were actually reached. Official LIBERO reward is outside this motion-only contract.
